title: Garnet is working too hard

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Do you feel as tired as I look?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you feel as tired as I look?

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Haha. Thanks for that. It's nice to see a friendly face. I hope your customers been treating you better than mines are treating me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haha. Thanks for that. It's nice to see a friendly face. I hope your customers been treating you better than mines are treating me.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Oh, before you go, I forgot to say. I got a daughter. A real one! Mila is her name. And she wants to talk to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, before you go, I forgot to say. I got a daughter. A real one! Mila is her name. And she wants to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Look, it's real sweet of her, so just indulge her, ok. I know no one wants me as a partner, and not many want me as a friend either.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, it's real sweet of her, so just indulge her, ok. I know no one wants me as a partner, and not many want me as a friend either.
Appreciate it! See ya around.
Hi again.
No one feels THAT tired.
Some nights.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You still look good to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You still look good to me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You still look good to me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You still look good to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Just... go along with it ok. She's a good kid. She has this idea that I need to find a friend or a partner or a... I dunno.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just... go along with it ok. She's a good kid. She has this idea that I need to find a friend or a partner or a... I dunno.
Interview them for WHAT?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No need to bribe me. I'll help out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No need to bribe me. I'll help out.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No need to bribe me. I'll help out.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No need to bribe me. I'll help out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Make it two.
Way better than Anna!

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: She's kinda protective, and any time she sees me talk with someone new, she wants to... interview them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's kinda protective, and any time she sees me talk with someone new, she wants to... interview them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: As if I'm applying for a job?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As if I'm applying for a job?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: As if I'm applying for a job?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: As if I'm applying for a job?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Now you're being too hard on yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now you're being too hard on yourself.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Now you're being too hard on yourself.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Now you're being too hard on yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's fishing for compliments, right?

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: The kid is pushy. So just.... go along with it. If you do, I'll buy you a coffee or two, ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The kid is pushy. So just.... go along with it. If you do, I'll buy you a coffee or two, ok?
